summary: Iteration 2 tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (AI Pathway EN + MR, admin auth for events/blog/testimonials listings, full create->public GET->delete cycles). Frontend: Hero 'Find My Pathway' CTA opens 6-step wizard, submit returns a real 2158-char Claude response with disclaimer. /programs index renders 4 cards (usmle, residency, bachelors, masters); /programs/usmle detail page loads with hero, who-for, why, eligibility, timeline, 3 FAQs and CTA. Admin dashboard shows all 5 tabs (Leads, Messages, Events, Blog, Testimonials); Event, Blog and Testimonial forms all publish and are immediately reflected in admin tables and on public /blog and /testimonials.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 538-line file mixing models, admin routes, AI integration and seed. Consider splitting into routers/models/services modules once feature set stabilises (>700-line risk soon).
PathwayRequest allows all fields optional — backend accepts a fully-empty payload which will still hit the LLM and consume credits. Consider requiring at least one substantive field.
ai/pathway does not persist queries — no way to see what users are asking. Consider storing anonymised pathway requests + response for iteration.
Admin CMS forms lack data-testid on individual inputs/submit buttons (only tabs and login have them). Adding them would make automation more robust.

Blog admin form uses `input[type='number']` for read_time and controlled slug normalisation only on typed input — pasting spaces followed by programmatic submit is fine, but consider trimming on submit as well.
Program detail page hardcodes all 4 programs in a large in-file constant (Programs.jsx ~430 lines). Fine for MVP; consider moving PROGRAMS map to a JSON/i18n file for editorial handoff.

PathwayAssistant response is rendered with `whitespace-pre-wrap` on raw text — no markdown rendering. Claude output includes markdown-style bold/lists that render as raw ** and dashes. Consider react-markdown for prettier output.
No length cap / rate limiting on /api/ai/pathway — an abusive client can burn Emergent LLM key credits. Consider adding basic per-IP throttling.
seed_data_creation: Backend test cycles created + cleaned TEST_ prefixed events/blog/testimonials each run. UI test also created TEST_UI_Event EN, TEST_UI_Post EN (slug test-ui-post-abc), TEST_UI_Testim — all deleted at end via admin API. Final state: 4 events, 4 blog posts, 5 testimonials (original seed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 additions all pass. New pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py (11 tests, ~35s including 2 LLM calls). Note: root pytest.ini enables xdist auto — run with `-o addopts=` or install xdist properly if adding more tests. Admin CMS forms use placeholder-based inputs only (no per-field data-testid); UI Playwright uses placeholder selectors which is stable but brittle to copy changes. LLM latency ~10-15s per pathway call, timeouts set to 60s in tests.
